title: Settings
ap_theme_sub: Light, dark, or whatever this computer uses.
ap_colour_sub: The frame, sidebar and highlights. Messages stay on a calm, neutral background.
ap_text_size_sub: Messages and the message box. Everything else keeps its size.
ap_layout_sub: A stream with names, or bubbles with your messages on the right.
ap_time_sub: Message times and clocks: as your language writes them, or always 12- or 24-hour.
ap_previews_sub: The last message under each conversation in the list: always, only while it''s unread, or never.
ap_animoji_sub: Animated emoji play in conversations. Off: they''re shown still (they''re still sent animated).
ap_autophoto_sub: Received photos are decrypted and shown as they arrive. Off: each waits for a click. Videos and files always wait.
ap_quality_sub: Where sending photos starts; each send can still change it. Standard and HD also remove camera details such as location.
ap_swipe_sub: On a touch screen, swipe a message to the left to reply to it.
ap_doubletap_sub: Double-tap a message (with a mouse, double-click beside its text) to react with this emoji; again takes it back.
ap_links_sub: Every link shows where it goes before it opens. Off: only links that look misleading ask.
ap_media_sub: Show YouTube, Spotify and similar links as cards that open the provider''s site. Nothing is fetched.
ap_youtube_sub: YouTube videos play here in YouTube''s privacy-enhanced player, loaded only when you press Play. Off: they open on YouTube.
ap_enter_sub: Off: Enter adds a line and Ctrl+Enter (⌘+Enter) sends.
nt_desktop_blocked: Blocked in your browser''s site settings. Allow notifications for this site there, then turn this on.
nt_desktop_sub: A notification when a message or call arrives while you''re looking elsewhere.
nt_groups_sub: Off: groups and channels stay quiet; mentions of you still notify.
nt_in_app_sub: A short chime for new direct messages, mentions and conversations you follow, even without desktop notifications. Never for your own messages, the conversation you''re reading, or muted ones.
nt_in_app_locked: Your browser plays sound only after you click on the page. Click anywhere, or press Play a test sound.
nt_in_app_unsupported: This browser can''t play sounds for Meldiq.
nt_sound_sub: Notifications play your system''s notification sound. Off: they arrive silently.
nt_ring_sub: Meldiq''s own ringtone while a call rings in this tab. Off: the call card and notification only.
nt_receipts_sub: In direct messages and groups of up to 20, people see when you''ve read their messages. Reading here also clears unread on your phone.
nt_typing_sub: Let others see when you''re typing.
